The implemented features (API settings, content calendar, marketing agents) appear to be partial implementations of marketing capabilities added to the main Auto-Claude application, but they are incomplete and not integrated.

root_cause_analysis.likely_scenario: This appears to be either: 1) A work-in-progress feature branch for adding marketing capabilities to Auto-Claude, 2) A misunderstanding of project scope, or 3) Tasks were generated for a 'Marketing Hub' feature that was planned but never fully implemented.
